decisions.reason: The streamlined layout and tighter spacing do not change the established font-type or font-size consistency rules.
The one-page cover-letter requirement from message 91 is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event.
Using fewer custom section treatments does not alter the approved photo source, mandatory photo selection, or requirement to place photos.
The layout simplification and spacing change do not alter the Blue Mesa Strategies identity, logo, or color requirements.
The page-limit impact of tightening paragraph and section spacing is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY Event.
The source changes general layout treatment and spacing but does not change inclusion or placement requirements for the organization chart.
The streamlined layout approach does not change the requirement to integrate the supplied revised tables.
The source does not change the biography count, affiliation, content source, or insertion method.
Layout simplification and tighter spacing do not alter the requirement that hyperlinks remain functional in the final file.
The source changes presentation density, not which required RFQ content must be included in the document.
Fewer custom treatments and tighter spacing do not change the fixed section order or prohibition on reordering.
The layout approach does not alter Canva editing access, ownership, or the free-assets-only policy.
